name: Solis
tagline: Ready-made website for solar energy installers
description: Solis is a website template for solar energy installers, with a hero that shows the key figures of a typical home system, an interactive sun-over-roof section where visitors pick a month and a time of day, a subsidy guide step by step, recent projects with yearly savings and pages for solar panels, heat pumps and home batteries. Deep petrol, warm peach and a sky that moves from morning to evening as you scroll give the website a calm, honest character. Replace the copy, figures, subsidy details, photos, reviews and legal pages with your own before publishing.
features: Hero with a sun arc and the key figures of a typical system
Interactive sun-over-roof section with month and time-of-day controls
Three service pages: solar panels, heat pumps and home batteries, each with a cost and payback table
Subsidy guide, step by step, with who does what, how long it takes and the amount
Recent projects with system size and yearly saving
FAQ on net-billing, subsidies and servicing
Client reviews, to be replaced with genuine testimonials
Free energy audit form with a sticky audit tab
